initialPrompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production 2D pixel-art character animation sprite sheet for a side-scrolling platform game.
Input image 1: exact character identity, pixel-art style and idle-pose reference. Preserve this green-haired young witch's appearance: oversized bent purple pointed hat with dark plum underside, gold crescent moon ornament and small stars, pointed ears, pale face with amber eyes, flowing lime/olive hair, dark purple short witch outfit with gold trim and lilac fabric panels, purple boots, and the small gold-ringed purple crystal wand held in her forward hand. Preserve the chibi proportions and detailed 1-pixel dark outlines of the reference. Do not redesign into a different witch.
Create EXACTLY 18 fully separated full-body animation frames laid out as exactly 6 columns and 3 rows on a TRANSPARENT canvas, ideally 1536x768, uniform square 256x256 cells, NO labels, NO gridlines, NO shadows, NO floor, NO background color/checkerboard, NO motion trails, NO speed lines, NO other objects. Every frame completely fits in its own cell with ample clear margins around hat and wand. Same consistent character scale in every cell, about 200 pixels from hat tip to sole in standing poses. All frames face RIGHT in the same side-three-quarter view as the reference. Crisp genuine pixel art with square pixel clusters, a controlled reference-matching palette, no painterly strokes, no smooth vector contours, no blur or antialiasing.
ROW 1 is a smooth SIX-FRAME WALK LOOP: right-foot forward contact; lower recoil; right leg behind while left knee passes; left-foot forward contact; lower recoil opposite; left leg behind while right knee passes. Small relaxed forward body lean, subtle up/down body movement, natural alternating feet, secondary hair/hat/skirt motion. The final frame must smoothly return to frame 1. Feet ground at same cell-local baseline near y=232.
ROW 2 is a distinct SIX-FRAME DASH/RUN LOOP: strong forward lean, visibly longer strides, alternating airborne and compressed contact phases, bent pumping free arm, wand held safely ahead, hair and skirt trailing backwards. Right-foot extended contact; compressed support; airborne passing; left-foot extended contact; compressed support opposite; airborne passing opposite. Dynamic but consistent anatomy with exactly two arms and two legs. Same cell-local ground baseline y=232, consistent pelvis x around128. Do not merely repeat the walking frames.
ROW 3 is a SIX-FRAME JUMP SEQUENCE: 1 anticipation crouch; 2 upward takeoff pushing toes off ground; 3 ascent with knees tucked and hair trailing down; 4 floating apex with bent legs and balanced wand; 5 descent feet extending downward and hair lifting; 6 soft landing crouch. Pose differences must be clear and legible at small game size. In airborne frames keep the character anchored around the same local pelvis/feet origin; actual world-height trajectory is controlled by the game, do not move the entire sprite across the cell. This is jumping on foot, NOT broom flight.
Every frame must remain the same recognizable character as the input; preserve face, hat crescent, green hair, costume design, wand, boots, handedness. No added scarf or backpack. Keep all 18 characters disjoint with fully transparent gutters. Output only the actual transparent animation sheet.
